options.content: Controller frame freshness, readiness, warnings, and stage timings.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(to_timestamp((CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) / 1000.0), e.ts))::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) AS "time",
  CASE
  WHEN kv.key LIKE '%_sec' THEN substring(kv.key from 1 for length(kv.key) - 4)
  WHEN kv.key LIKE '%_ms' THEN substring(kv.key from 1 for length(kv.key) - 3)
  ELSE kv.key
END AS metric,
  CASE
  WHEN kv.key LIKE '%_sec' THEN (CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(kv.value, '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(kv.value, ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) * 1000.0
  ELSE (CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(kv.value, '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(kv.value, ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END)
END AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(COALESCE(e.payload #> ARRAY['optimizer','timing'], '{}'::jsonb)) AS kv(key, value)
WHERE e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND ($__timeFilter(e.ts))
  AND kv.key <> 'best_epoch'
  AND trim(kv.value) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
ORDER BY 1

WITH buckets AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeFrom())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)),
    to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)),
    make_interval(secs => GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001))
  ) AS "time"
),
metrics AS (
  SELECT 'warnings'::text AS metric
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT w.warning AS metric
  FROM mm_events e
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(e.payload->'warnings', '[]'::jsonb)) AS w(warning)
  WHERE e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND ($__timeFilter(e.ts))
),
data AS (
SELECT
  to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(to_timestamp((CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) / 1000.0), e.ts))::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) AS "time",
  w.warning AS metric,
  COUNT(*)::double precision AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(e.payload->'warnings', '[]'::jsonb)) AS w(warning)
WHERE e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND ($__timeFilter(e.ts))
GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT b."time", m.metric, COALESCE(d.value, 0.0) AS value
FROM buckets b
CROSS JOIN metrics m
LEFT JOIN data d
  ON d."time" = b."time"
 AND d.metric = m.metric
ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT e.ts, e.actor_id, e.exchange, e.symbol, w.warning
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(e.payload->'warnings', '[]'::jsonb)) AS w(warning)
WHERE e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND ($__timeFilter(e.ts))
ORDER BY e.ts DESC
LIMIT 100

SELECT exchange
FROM (
  SELECT exchange, max(ts) AS latest_ts
  FROM (
  SELECT exchange, ts
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE exchange IS NOT NULL
    AND exchange <> ''
    AND event_type IN ('StrategyDecision', 'ControllerDiagnostics', 'JointTargetBook')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT gates.key AS exchange, e.ts
  FROM mm_events e
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(
    COALESCE(e.payload #> ARRAY['execution_gates','venue_gates'], '{}'::jsonb)
  ) AS gates(key, value)
  WHERE e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
    AND gates.key IS NOT NULL
    AND gates.key <> ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT payload #>> ARRAY['local_market','exchange'] AS exchange, ts
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE event_type = 'JointStrategyFrame'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT payload #>> ARRAY['global_market','exchange'] AS exchange, ts
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE event_type = 'JointStrategyFrame'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT exchange, ts
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE event_type = 'MarketEvent'
    AND exchange IS NOT NULL
    AND exchange <> ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT exchange, ts
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE event_type IN ('PrivateStateSnapshot', 'VenueLedgerSnapshot')
    AND exchange IS NOT NULL
    AND exchange <> ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT COALESCE(
      exchange,
      payload->>'exchange',
      substring(topic from '^private:state:([^:]+):snapshot$'),
      substring(topic from '^ledger:snapshot:([^:]+)$')
    ) AS exchange,
    ts
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE event_type IN ('PrivateStateSnapshot', 'VenueLedgerSnapshot')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT exchange, ts
  FROM mm_market_facts
  WHERE exchange IS NOT NULL AND exchange <> ''
  ) sources
  WHERE exchange IS NOT NULL AND exchange <> ''
  GROUP BY exchange
) ranked
ORDER BY latest_ts DESC

SELECT interval_ms
FROM (
  SELECT interval_ms, max(latest_ts) AS latest_ts
  FROM (
    SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(payload->>'interval_ms', ''), substring(topic from ':([0-9]+)$')) AS interval_ms, ts AS latest_ts
    FROM mm_events
    WHERE COALESCE(NULLIF(payload->>'interval_ms', ''), substring(topic from ':([0-9]+)$')) IS NOT NULL
      AND COALESCE(NULLIF(payload->>'interval_ms', ''), substring(topic from ':([0-9]+)$')) <> ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT interval_ms::text AS interval_ms, ts AS latest_ts
    FROM mm_market_facts
    WHERE interval_ms IS NOT NULL
  ) sources
  GROUP BY interval_ms
) ranked
ORDER BY latest_ts DESC
